info.name: Penpot Sync
info.summary: Your Penpot design files as native, read-only, backed-up Nextcloud files
info.description:
Penpot Sync mirrors your Penpot design files into Nextcloud as native files. A scheduled pull walks your mapped Penpot teams/projects and every design file appears in Nextcloud as a `.penpot` file — a real file icon, a deep link back to the live design in Penpot, and a local backup of the exported archive.
Unlike this app's sibling integrations for n8n and Grafana, Penpot Sync is **read-only**: there is no "Edit as text" action and no Nextcloud → Penpot writeback. A `.penpot` export is an opaque archive of nested design data — editing it outside Penpot wouldn't produce anything sane to re-import. Design happens in Penpot; Nextcloud holds the backup and the click-through.
⚠️ **Very early development.** The admin surface is complete — instance URL, service-account token, team mappings, scheduled-pull settings, and an optional per-user token for attribution — and every control has an `occ` twin. But there is still **no sync engine and no file actions: nothing is mirrored yet.** You can configure the app fully and verify it reaches your Penpot (`occ penpot_sync:test-connection` reports which teams the account can see), and that is all it does today. See the project's `saga/` design narrative for what's confirmed, what's locked, and what's still an open question.
The `enable-access-tokens` Penpot instance flag is required to mint the token; it is off by default upstream.
This is a community integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Penpot (Kaleidos Ventures SL). "Penpot" and the Penpot logo are trademarks of their respective owner, used here only to identify the service this app integrates with.
